description: This Java class defines configuration properties for the AMQP protocol adapter, including parameters such as maximum frame size, maximum session frames, and idle timeout. It provides getters and setters with validation for these properties and extends a base protocol adapter properties class.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties class for the AMQP protocol adapter, managing various operational parameters such as frame size, session frames, and timeouts.

methods.name: getMaxFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of an AMQP frame in bytes.

methods.name: setMaxFrameSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of an AMQP frame, with validation that it must be at least 512 bytes.

methods.name: getMaxSessionFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of transfer frames in flight for an AMQP session.

methods.name: setMaxSessionFrames
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of transfer frames in flight for an AMQP session, must be at least 1.

methods.name: getMaxSessionWindowSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum session window size based on frame and session limits.

methods.name: setIdleTimeout
methods.description: Sets the idle timeout period in milliseconds; a value of zero disables timeout detection.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured idle timeout period in milliseconds.
